_comment: NPC definitions. 'origin' is canon | invented. 'voice' is a one-line guardrail for writers. Portrait keys used in scene files are '<portrait_set>_<mood>'.

eddard_stark.name: Eddard Stark
eddard_stark.voice: Says the fewest words that will do. Never explains himself twice. Never says 'winter is coming'.

catelyn_stark.name: Catelyn Stark
catelyn_stark.voice: Southern manners over northern iron. Politest when most dangerous.

robb_stark.name: Robb Stark
robb_stark.voice: Fifteen. Learns to sound certain about three weeks before he is.

bran_stark.name: Bran Stark
bran_stark.voice: Repeats things when frightened. 'I don't fall.'

arya_stark.name: Arya Stark
arya_stark.voice: Never speaks on screen in Chapter 1. Seen twice, at a run.

sansa_stark.name: Sansa Stark
sansa_stark.voice: Everything she says has been taught to her. That is the tragedy, not a flaw.

jon_snow.name: Jon Snow
jon_snow.voice: Act 1 only. Two lines. Leaves the frame.

theon_greyjoy.name: Theon Greyjoy
theon_greyjoy.voice: Jokes first, and one beat too early, every time.

jory_cassel.name: Jory Cassel
jory_cassel.voice: Practical kindness with no sentiment on it. The player must like him; Act 2 depends on it.

robert_baratheon.name: Robert Baratheon
robert_baratheon.voice: Enormous and grieving and never introduced with a fat joke.

cersei_lannister.name: Cersei Lannister
cersei_lannister.voice: Bored. Boredom is the threat. She is never shrill.

joffrey_baratheon.name: Joffrey Baratheon
joffrey_baratheon.voice: Delighted. Twelve. Not evil so much as unsupervised.

petyr_baelish.name: Petyr Baelish
petyr_baelish.voice: Tells the truth in a tone that makes it sound like a joke.

varys.name: Varys
varys.voice: Speaks to the room while addressing one person in it.

grand_maester_pycelle.name: Grand Maester Pycelle
grand_maester_pycelle.voice: Doddering on purpose. His hands give him away, not his voice.

meryn_trant.name: Ser Meryn Trant
meryn_trant.voice: Flat, incurious, unhurried. Frightening because he is not interested.

greatjon_umber.name: Greatjon Umber
greatjon_umber.voice: Volume as a personality. Quiet exactly once, in the wood.

rickard_karstark.name: Rickard Karstark
rickard_karstark.voice: Counts his sons. Do not write him as a villain; he has not become one yet.

galbart_glover.name: Galbart Glover
galbart_glover.voice: Dry. Deals in numbers. The chapter's realist.

wyman_manderly.name: Wyman Manderly
wyman_manderly.voice: Jovial and shrewd, in that order, and never only the first.

walder_frey.name: Walder Frey
walder_frey.voice: Enjoying himself. Ninety and finally necessary.

tobho_mott.name: Tobho Mott
tobho_mott.voice: Busy. Everyone is in his light.

gendry.name: Gendry
gendry.voice: Sixteen, blunt, apologetic about his own work. Do not hint. Just show his face.

ondrew_slate.name: Lord Ondrew Slate
ondrew_slate.voice: Tired and practical. Unimpressed by his fourth son and not unkind about it.

hune.name: Serjeant Hune
hune.voice: Blunt, fair, never sentimental. Dies in the Whispering Wood with no cutscene.

mabb.name: Old Mabb
mabb.voice: Seventy-one. Fourth king. Talks about flour at the worst moment and means it.

pate.name: Pate of the Kitchens
pate.voice: Fourteen and cannot hold a secret for one afternoon.

wells.name: Ser Emmon Wells
wells.voice: Southron contempt that slowly turns into respect he is embarrassed about.

cley.name: Ser Cley Stout
cley.voice: Torren's own age and rank, and unbothered by both. Jokes first, works last, sees more than he admits. The only person Torren is not performing for.

stranger.name: An old man
stranger.voice: One scene, three lines, never explained. Chapter 2 hook.

rodrik_cassel.name: Ser Rodrik Cassel
rodrik_cassel.voice: Master-at-arms. Bellows. Whiskers. Fair, and entirely out of patience.

maester_luwin.name: Maester Luwin
maester_luwin.voice: Precise under pressure. Goes quiet exactly when it is worst.

benjen_stark.name: Benjen Stark
benjen_stark.voice: Talks about the Wall the way a man talks about a debt nobody else believes in.

tyrion_lannister.name: Tyrion Lannister
tyrion_lannister.voice: Tests everyone with a joke and reads the answer. Never self-pitying on screen.

stable_hand.name: Stable Hand
stable_hand.voice: Has never been past the winter town and says so.
